module.purpose: Retrieves the complete persisted configuration for a booking event type, including hosts, calendars, schedules, workflows, locations, booking constraints, and team settings. It validates and normalizes database values into the response model consumed by new-booking handling.
module.summary: The file defines a comprehensive Prisma selection for event type retrieval and a database-backed loader that transforms the result into booking-ready data. It enriches users and hosts with selected calendars, determines organizational team context, validates metadata, custom inputs, recurring-event settings, and round-robin segment values, resolves booking fields with system fields, and supplies normalized defaults for locations, host groups, and dynamic-event status.
module.businessContext:
This supports scheduling and booking flows by providing the event configuration needed to create new bookings.
Failures can prevent valid event types from loading or produce incorrect availability, routing, pricing, confirmation, or attendee experiences.
